verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe running LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators automatically on live production traces (not just datasets), with sampling and reference-free checks, plus scoring via API/SDK and alerts on metric thresholds; a dedicated hallucination-detection guide shows an evaluator running continuously 'on a sample of live traffic'. This is corroborated by both docs and a resources article contrasting offline experiments vs. managed production evaluators. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of continuous production evaluation performance at scale beyond vendor docs.
